name: Encrypted Parchment
summary: In the Valley of Trials, Encrypted Parchment guides young orc rogues toward the Den. Gornek hands it to recruits who show promise, and its cipher points them to Rwag, the hidden trainer.

sections.title: A Summons from the Shadows
sections.body: Young orcs prove their strength in the Valley of Trials under the open sun. Those who show a gift for stealth, deception, and bladecraft draw different notice. After facing the local wildlife, promising orc rogues receive Encrypted Parchment from Gornek. Its coded words call to those who can read a message meant to stay hidden.

sections.title: Ties to the Shattered Hand
sections.body: The cipher leads a novice into the Den, past the other clan trainers, to find Rwag. The recruit learns there that the Shattered Hand arranged the summons. The order works within the Horde's covert network, and answering the call begins a rogue's training in espionage and shadowcraft.

faq.q: What is the purpose of the Encrypted Parchment?
faq.answer: Encrypted Parchment is a coded summons that guides novice orc rogues to their trainer, Rwag, inside the Den in the Valley of Trials.

faq.q: Who sends the parchment to you?
faq.answer: Gornek hands you the parchment after your first trials in the valley. Its message comes from Rwag, the rogue trainer.

faq.q: Why is the message written in cipher?
faq.answer: Rwag and his contacts in the Shattered Hand favor secrecy. The cipher guides recruits suited to the subtle path of a rogue into their hidden ranks.

faq.q: What organization is behind the summons?
faq.answer: Rwag reveals that the Shattered Hand asked him to watch for capable recruits. The order trains rogues in stealth and espionage to serve the Horde from the shadows.

faq.q: Can troll rogues use this parchment?
faq.answer: No. Troll rogues also begin in the Valley of Trials, but they receive an Encrypted Tablet instead.

angles.text: As a rogue, you receive a summons to train in the Horde's covert arts with mentors tied to the Shattered Hand.
As an orc, you may favor open, honorable combat, but this missive welcomes those whose talents lie in the quieter, deadlier arts of survival.
